scripts.lint: npm --workspace @build-manager/web run lint && npm --workspace @build-manager/mobile run lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.packages.json --noEmit && npm --workspace @build-manager/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @build-manager/mobile run typecheck
scripts.check:deps: npm ls react && npm ls react-dom && npm ls react-native && npm ls expo
scripts.verify: npm run test:shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run check:deps
